name: Half Speed
description: Plays what you are playing at half speed as you play it: an octave down and twice as slow, in repeating cycles that can chop like a rhythm or run together into one slow, deep bed.

params.name: Power
params.description: Off passes the dry signal. Switching it fades over a moment, and switching On starts a new cycle from the note being played.

params.name: Length
params.description: How long each cycle lasts before the slowed sound jumps forward to catch up with your playing. Short cycles stutter; long ones drag whole phrases out behind you.

params.name: Speed
params.description: How slow the playback runs, and so how far the pitch drops: a fourth, a fifth, one octave or two octaves down. A change bends the pitch like a tape machine changing speed.

params.name: Fade
params.description: How much of each cycle is spent fading from the old cycle into the new one. Low is a tight cut, high lets the end of one cycle wash over the start of the next.

params.name: Smooth
params.description: At zero you hear each cycle start, a rhythm of slowed chunks. Turning it up brings in a second playback half a cycle behind, until at full the jumps disappear into one continuous slowed sound.

params.name: Jitter
params.description: Makes every cycle a little longer or shorter than the last, so the jumps stop ticking like a machine.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Removes lows from the slowed sound, which keeps a thick source from turning to mud an octave down.

params.name: High Cut
params.description: Removes highs from the slowed sound, for a darker bed that sits under the dry signal.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Lets the right side run its cycles later than the left, so the jumps land at different moments and the slowed sound widens. The bass stays together.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the slowed sound.
